sizing.rationale: Whole paired deals; largest power-of-two batch targeting three hours under a doubled measured per-game envelope. Filter conservatively uses the slower search envelope. Pilot outcomes are excluded.

runtime_source.resource_reason: 900s setup plus twice the largest observed v1 batch wall time (including the failed shard), within 75% of the timeout. Four games per job; measurements are planning bounds, not strength or admission.
